messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — we plan to publish the "Redwood Throughput Benchmark: ~4x inference density on A100" blog + benchmark tomorrow 10:00 PT. Press embargo until 10:00 PT. We're coordinating press and socials here. Draft blog: https://drive.example.com/redwood/bench/draft.md

Ajay Patel: On it — I'll ping top tech reporters and developer outlets. Need embargo time in ISO and a one‑pager + embargo copy. Also want top-line numbers (p50/p95 latencies, throughput, cost improvements).

Samir Khan: Attached bench summary in doc: https://drive.example.com/redwood/bench/summary.pdf. Highlights: ~4x throughput vs baseline, ~35% cost reduction with packing+quant. Can pull p50/p95 tables and methodology. Happy to write a 1‑paragraph product blurb.

Elena R.: Legal: need to review claim language around "4x" and "35%". Please add a methodology section and reproducibility notes. Confirm no customer data in figures. I need the final draft by EOD.

pressbot: Press list exported: https://drive.example.com/press/press-list.csv — includes TechCrunch, The Verge, VentureBeat, Wired, InfoQ and several dev outlets.

Taylor (Ops): Telemetry and demo cluster ready. Can run one last baseline at publish time. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/bench/2024-q1. We'll tag blog with demo link and enable a short-lived demo env.

Maria Chen: Thanks team. I'll attach CEO quote placeholder in the draft. @Samir — can you send final p50/p95 numbers by 16:00 PT? @Elena — will you post legal signoff here when ready? Social assets in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Plan: blog live 2024-05-03T17:00Z (10:00 PT). Embargo lifts at that time.

Ajay Patel: Scheduling note: prefer simultaneous release at embargo lift (T0). I'll prep a short teaser email for top reporters and coordinate embargo handling.

Samir Khan: Posted final numbers to the doc: p50=32ms, p95=120ms, throughput 4.1x, cost/unit 0.65x baseline. Methodology: https://drive.example.com/redwood/bench/method.md

Elena R.: Legal reviewed — minor wording tweak: change "4x" → "approximately 4x" and add the methodology link in the claims. No remaining legal issues; signed off.

Maria Chen: :party-parrot: Great. Final checklist: blog draft, final assets, social copy, press list, CEO quote, legal signoff. I'll trigger publish at 2024-05-03T17:00Z. If anything blocks, flag here immediately.

Ajay Patel: I'll set embargo emails and DM top reporters 30 min before publish.

DeployBot: Publishing job queued. Waiting on Maria Chen to trigger manual publish.

Maria Chen: Will publish at 17:00Z. Thanks everyone — will post post-launch metrics in #marketing after 24h.
